name: sheets-vscode
description: Open, edit and chart .xlsx and .csv files like in Excel. Includes language model tools so AI agents can operate spreadsheets.

sheets.agentTools.headlessWrites.description: Allow language model tools to modify spreadsheet files that are not open in an editor (changes are saved to disk).

languageModelTools.name: sheets_get_workbook_info
languageModelTools.userDescription: Overview of the workbook: sheets with their used ranges and charts, the active sheet, defined names and the current user selection
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Overview of the workbook: sheets with their used ranges and charts, the active sheet, defined names and the current user selection. Call this first to orient yourself.

file.description: Path (absolute or workspace-relative) or URI of the .xlsx/.csv file. Defaults to the spreadsheet open in the active Sheets editor.

languageModelTools.name: sheets_read_range
languageModelTools.userDescription: Reads cell values from a range
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads cell values from a range. Returns a 2D array of computed values (numbers, strings, booleans, null for empty, "#ERR!" strings for errors) plus formulas for cells that contain them. Use format "markdown" for a readable table, "display" for formatted text as the user sees it.

file.description: Path (absolute or workspace-relative) or URI of the .xlsx/.csv file. Defaults to the spreadsheet open in the active Sheets editor.

sheet.description: Sheet name. Defaults to the active sheet.

range.description: A1 range, e.g. "A1:D20", "B:B" or "Sheet2!A1:C5". Whole columns/rows are clipped to the used area.

languageModelTools.name: sheets_write_range
languageModelTools.userDescription: Writes a 2D array of values starting at a cell
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Writes a 2D array of values starting at a cell. Strings starting with "=" are formulas (e.g. "=SUM(B2:B10)"); other strings are parsed like typed input ("12%", "2024-01-31", "1,234.5"). null clears a cell. Existing formatting is kept. Returns the computed values of written formulas.

file.description: Path (absolute or workspace-relative) or URI of the .xlsx/.csv file. Defaults to the spreadsheet open in the active Sheets editor.

sheet.description: Sheet name. Defaults to the active sheet.

parse.description: Parse strings like typed input (default true). Set false to store text literally.

languageModelTools.name: sheets_fill_formula
languageModelTools.userDescription: Writes one formula into every cell of a range, adjusting relative references like Excel's fill-down/right
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Writes one formula into every cell of a range, adjusting relative references like Excel's fill-down/right. The formula is written as it should appear in the top-left cell, e.g. range "D2:D100", formula "=B2*C2".

file.description: Path (absolute or workspace-relative) or URI of the .xlsx/.csv file. Defaults to the spreadsheet open in the active Sheets editor.

sheet.description: Sheet name. Defaults to the active sheet.

formula.description: Formula for the top-left cell, starting with "="

languageModelTools.name: sheets_clear_range
languageModelTools.userDescription: Clears a range
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Clears a range. mode "contents" keeps formatting, "formats" keeps values, "all" removes everything.

file.description: Path (absolute or workspace-relative) or URI of the .xlsx/.csv file. Defaults to the spreadsheet open in the active Sheets editor.

sheet.description: Sheet name. Defaults to the active sheet.

borders.description: Optional thin borders around/inside the range
